name: Active-bin replenishment continuation
hypothesis: Buy after sell-side pressure is absorbed and fresh active-bin liquidity remains while price resumes upward.
spec: Setup: Repeated replenishment near price may absorb sales without stalling demand. Entry: Buy after sell-side pressure is absorbed and fresh active-bin liquidity remains while price resumes upward. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit when replenishment stops or the defended price fails. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs executable DEX pool depth and quote history (not connected)
